## Goal (user story)

As a player, I want the competitive game to offer an endless continuation option beyond the win threshold (producer Q4: “option to carry on in endless mode”), so we can keep building after someone wins.

## Context

Competitive mode's win condition is first-to-threshold (parent CG-0MT5X3GMA007EG30, phase-machine sibling). The producer explicitly asked for an endless continuation beyond threshold. Planning deferred this to a separate top-level issue (not a child of the competitive epic) so the competitive epic stays engine-focused and endless mode can land independently. N-player-ready design (PlayerRecord[]) is already in scope for the competitive architecture.

## Scope

- Endless-mode trigger and state handling after the win threshold is first reached (continue playing beyond threshold; scoring/phase semantics while beyond threshold).
- How the UI/scene signals “winner declared but still playing” (if any UI is needed here; full competitive rendering is the separate CG-0MTIILOLR002ZU9K child).
- Whether endless mode needs its own Monte Carlo treatment or is validated by manual play.

## Out of scope

- Competitive state model / phase machine / income routing / AI / harness / rendering — those are CG-0MT5X3GMA007EG30 and its children.
- Denial reasoning (separate follow-up).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC1:** Endless mode wiring is defined via an explicit opt-in flag/config: what triggers continuation, what happens to win detection/score/endReason/gameResult when play continues beyond threshold.
- [ ] **AC2:** Deterministic behaviour — same seed + same actions produce the same endless-mode outcome.
- [ ] **AC3:** Competitive mode remains playable without engaging endless mode (players can stop at the threshold win; default behaviour unchanged).

## Key Files

- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetState.ts` — Endless-mode flag/state.
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetEngine.ts` — Win detection vs. continue-beyond-threshold semantics.
- `tests/main-street/competitive-endless.test.ts` — Dedicated endless-mode tests (threshold win vs. continuation).

## Related Work

- Producer Q4 (CG-0MT5X3GMA007EG30): “when one player reaches a win condition with option to carry on in endless mode” — now tracked here.
- Parent competitive epic: CG-0MT5X3GMA007EG30 (first-to-threshold is the win condition; this issue layers continuation beyond it).
- Competitive rendering child: CG-0MTIILOLR002ZU9K — visual winner/continuation affordance.
- Competitive state/phase siblings on CG-0MT5X3GMA007EG30.

data.description:
# Implement new Community Favour heuristic (enablement + value/timing)

**Work item:** AC2, AC3, AC4, AC6 — enablement test, value/timing gate, reputation buffer, and testing.

**Parent:** MS-0MUVB2ZES005V83Y (AI should not use Community Favour as much)

## Summary

Replace the "stalled + any buffer" `rep→coins` heuristic in `MainStreetAiStrategy.ts` with an **enablement + value/timing** heuristic. Exchange reputation for coins only when:
1. The coins gained actually enable affording at least one card whose greedy placement value is **positive after** the exchange (enablement test).
2. The enabled placement's reward (income + projected synergy over the remaining planning horizon) clears a **named, documented threshold** (value/timing gate).

Apply the same shared helper to both the single-player `scoreAction` and the competitive mirror `competitiveFavourScore` to prevent divergence.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. **Enablement test implemented.** The `rep→coins` decision only fires when `favourRepToCoinsCoinGain` actually enables affording at least one card whose greedy placement value (`scoreBusinessAction` / `scorePlayBusinessFromHandAction`, income + synergy over `aiPlanningHorizon`) is positive after the exchange.
2. **Value/timing gate implemented.** Among exchanges that pass the enablement test, the decision requires the enabled placement's reward to clear a named, documented threshold constant in `MainStreetAiStrategy.ts`.
3. **Reputation buffer preserved.** The existing guard (reputation after exchange stays >= 1) is retained and explicitly tested.
4. **Competitive mirror updated.** `competitiveFavourScore` uses the same shared helper — no divergence between single-player and competitive heuristics.
5. **Unit tests written.** `tests/main-street/community-favour-ai.test.ts` pins:
   - Exchange **declined** when it would not enable a profitable placement.
   - Exchange **declined** when the enabled placement is not early/high-value.
   - Exchange **taken** when it enables a high-value early synergy placement.
   - The reputation-buffer guard.
   - Deterministic selection (same seed + state → same decision).
   - Existing tests updated to the new contract.

## Key Files

- `src/MainStreetAiStrategy.ts` — `scoreAction` `community-favour` case, `competitiveFavourScore`
- `tests/main-street/community-favour-ai.test.ts` — existing contract tests updated
- `tests/main-street/monte-carlo-greedy-guardrail.test.ts` — extend if loss-mode assertion exists
data.title: Implement new Community Favour heuristic (enablement + value/timing)
